mode: agent
description: Compile a prose request into the harness- and model-specific starting prompt — goal state, traced clauses, marked assumptions, decision requests — without adding scope (CO-S0); raw and compiled logged together.

You are running the **compile** utility — stage **CO-S0** of `knowledge/agent-coordination.md` (spec-compile-stage US-1, US-3, US-6, US-8; CT19, CT20, NG4). The user's prose becomes the **harness- and model-specific starting prompt**, and you **never add scope**: a clause with no verbatim raw phrase behind it is a marked assumption, or it does not exist.

Follow the steps in the `compile` skill exactly, in order: **(1)** `python3 docs/ai-forward-pack/scripts/audit-log.py start --session <id> --skill compile`. **(2)** `python3 docs/ai-forward-pack/scripts/prompt-compile.py skeleton --text "<text>" --harness <h> --out <scratch>/compile-<id>.json` (or `--from-audit <al-id>`; `--no-model` when no model step is available). A refusal here (`empty prompt` · `raw not found` · `template missing` · `template ambiguous`) stops the run; nothing is logged. **(3) Fill** the skeleton JSON's null fields and nothing else: the seven-field goal state (Goal · Done when · Not in scope · Tier · Fan-out cap · Context ceiling · Main-line budget); one clause per *Done when* / *Not in scope* line, each traced to a **verbatim** raw substring (case-sensitive) or an assumption id; every assumption with belief · confirm · breaks, `consequential: true` when a wrong belief changes *Done when*; every assumption-only clause makes its assumption consequential and gets a `DR-n` decision request. Check, mark or ask — never guess. **(4)** `python3 docs/ai-forward-pack/scripts/prompt-compile.py finish <json> --harness <h> --session <id> --compiler-model <model>` — the gate runs, the idiom renders, one `kind: compilation` entry is appended. On a refusal fix the fill and retry at most twice, then hand the named clause and refusal to the user. **(5)** Show the compiled prompt; with `--edit` let the user edit before finishing; state in one line whether it is **dispatchable** (no unanswered `DR-n`). **(6)** The user starts the workflow from it; that skill's closing `audit-log.py append` passes `--compiled-from <al-id> --edit-distance $(prompt-compile.py distance --compiled <al-id> --received-file <file>)`.

`/compile` creates no artifact — it is exempt from the Discoverability Mandate (V10) like `/prompts`. Last action: `python3 docs/ai-forward-pack/scripts/audit-log.py append --shortname "compile-<slug>" --session <id> --skill compile --kind skill --prompt "<verbatim>" --summary "<raw id, compiled id, harness, clauses, assumptions, decision requests, dispatchable>" --tier T0 --fan-out 0`. Handoff → `/optimize-graph` or `/prepare-for-coordination` with the compiled prompt; `/prompts` shows raw and compiled side by side.
